description: Polyphonic resonator: strings, plates, tubes and an organ machine, rung either by an audio signal you patch in or by a strike the module makes itself, across seven resonator models

params.text: Sets the coarse pitch across five octaves; with a cable in V/OCT it snaps to whole semitones, and with the Disastrous Peace model it sets the root note of the chord
Sets the character of the resonator: the ratio between partials, the tuning of the virtual strings, the amount of detuning, or the chord, according to the model in use
Sets the level of the higher harmonics, filtering the exciter up to noon and damping the high modes less past it; with FM voice it is the FM index, with Disastrous Peace the registration
Sets the decay time, from under 100ms to about 10 seconds; with FM voice it sets the FM index and amplitude decay, and with Disastrous Peace the decay and then the attack
Sets where the string or surface is struck; struck at the middle the even harmonics cancel. With FM voice it sets the feedback, none at noon, and with Disastrous Peace the effect amount
Attenuverts the jack that adds to the BRIGHTNESS knob, with a squared response that gives fine control near the centre
Attenuverts the frequency control voltage jack, bending the pitch four octaves either way; with nothing patched there that jack reads a twelfth of a volt, making this a fine tuning
Attenuverts the jack that adds to the DAMPING knob, with a squared response that gives fine control near the centre
Attenuverts the jack that adds to the STRUCTURE knob, with a squared response that gives fine control near the centre
Attenuverts the jack that adds to the POSITION knob, with a squared response that gives fine control near the centre
Picks the resonator model for every channel: modal resonator, sympathetic strings, modulated string, FM voice, quantized sympathetic strings, reverb string, or the Disastrous Peace organ machine
Sets how many notes one engine holds at once, one to four; at three the notes alternate between ODD and EVEN on an eight-step pattern, and with Disastrous Peace it sets overlapping chords
Steps through the six effects for channels running the Disastrous Peace model: a formant filter, a chorus, a reverb, and a variant of each; channels on any other model ignore it

inputs.text: Adds to the BRIGHTNESS knob through its attenuverter, 5V at full attenuverter driving the value past either end of the knob range
Shifts the pitch through the frequency attenuverter, as far as four octaves either way; with nothing patched it reads a twelfth of a volt
Adds to the DAMPING knob through its attenuverter, 5V at full attenuverter driving the value past either end of the knob range
Adds to the STRUCTURE knob through its attenuverter, 5V at full attenuverter driving the value past either end of the knob range
Adds to the POSITION knob through its attenuverter, 5V at full attenuverter driving the value past either end of the knob range
A voltage of 1V or more damps the note playing and starts the next; with nothing patched the module strums itself on note changes at V/OCT, or on transients at IN when V/OCT is empty
Sets the pitch of the resonator, one volt per octave
The audio that excites the resonator; with nothing patched the module makes its own strike, a low-pass filtered pulse or a burst of noise according to the model
Sets the resonator model for each channel outright, overriding the knob: a volt per model from 0V to 6V, or a semitone per model from C4 up when the note reading is on

outputs.text: The odd partials of the resonator, ±5V; with only one of the two outputs patched it carries both halves summed instead
The even partials of the resonator, ±5V; with only one of the two outputs patched it carries both halves summed instead

notes: the module is polyphonic: the channel count comes from whichever of STRUM, V/OCT and IN carries the most channels, and every channel gets its own resonator.
the control voltage jacks are read channel by channel, so a monophonic cable patched to one modulates the first channel alone and the rest keep their knob values.
both ODD and EVEN have to be patched for the two halves to be separated; patch one alone and it carries the two halves summed.
bypassing the module copies the IN jack to both outputs.
menu: Mode: Modal resonator, Sympathetic strings, Modulated / inharmonic string, FM voice, Quantized sympathetic strings, Reverb string, Disastrous Peace — picks the resonator model
Disastrous Peace FX: Formant filter, Rolandish chorus, Caveman reverb, Formant filter (less abrasive variant), Solinaish ensemble, Caveman reverb (shinier variant) — picks the effect
Options — the submenu holding the display and mode-input settings
Display channel — picks which polyphonic channel the model display and the note polyphony lamp report. It is on the Options submenu
C4-F#4 direct mode selection — reads the MODE jack as note pitches from C4 upwards rather than as one volt per model. It is on the Options submenu
Compatibility options — the submenu holding the settings that restore how older versions of the module behaved
Frequency knob center is C — adds 1.501V to the pitch so a centred FREQUENCY knob gives a C; switching it off restores the older tuning. It is on Compatibility options
